title: Star Citizen Hauling Mission
description: A single hauling mission as accepted by ingest_mission_batch.py and the deterministic scorer. All numeric fields may carry the string 'UNRESOLVED' when the value could not be read from the terminal.

issuer.description: Mission-issuing company. Overrides the batch-level issuer when present. Examples: 'covalex', 'Ling Family', 'Red Wind'.

pickup.description: Canonical name of the pickup location, or 'UNRESOLVED'.

delivery.description: Ordered list of delivery stop names. Each entry is a canonical location name or 'UNRESOLVED'.

cargo_type.description: Commodity label as shown on the terminal, or 'UNRESOLVED'.

fee_usc.description: Total fees deducted from reward (landing fees, freight elevator costs) in aUEC, or 'UNRESOLVED'.

atmosphere.description: Number of atmosphere-entry stops on this mission. Used by scorer's atmosphere penalty.

fragmentation.description: Number of distinct delivery stops. Higher values increase fragmentation penalty.

unresolved_fields.description: List of field names in this mission object that carry the UNRESOLVED sentinel.

notes.description: Free-text operator note attached to this mission. Not used in scoring.
